title: Car-free Streets are Amazing (and we need more of them)
summary: Not Just Bikes explains the Dutch concept of autoluw, or nearly car-free, streets and how it is applied across the Netherlands, with examples from Toronto and Copenhagen. It also covers Amsterdam's move toward a nearly car-free city.
why: HN commenters share it as a good overview of car-light street design and its effects in discussions of car-centric cities and the 15-minute city.

quote.text: Good overview about autoluw streets and the effects they have
